plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Biochemistry Major (BS) program page (poid=884). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the major requirement only; the full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Courses titled 'with Lab' carry separate lab corequisites in the catalog, each printed at 0 Hour(s); the 0-credit labs are disclosed in the notes and are not placed as separate courses. Catalog anomaly, transcribed as printed and not corrected: CHEM 120's detail page prints its prerequisite as 'XXX 111', and CHEM 110L's detail prints 'Lab component of XXX 111'; no such course exists in the catalog, so CHEM 120 carries no recorded prerequisite. The 0-credit lab corequisites in this plan are: BIOL 100L, BIOL 101L, BIOL 310L, CHEM 110L, CHEM 120L, CHEM 201L, CHEM 202L, PHYS 210L and PHYS 220L (Biochemistry/Chemistry subset as applicable), plus BIOL 205L when BIOL 205 is the statistics choice. The catalog states the major requires a minimum of sixty-three semester hours. Counting each cross-listed pair once (BCHM 311 is cross-listed with CHEM 311; BCHM 390 is cross-listed with CHEM 390; both pairs are printed as separate lines on the program page but are single courses) and one course from the Calculus II / statistics choice (MATH 101, BIOL 205 and MATH 107 are each 4 Hour(s)), the named courses sum to 61. The catalog's elective block ('BCHM, BIOL or CHEM electives, minimum of 6 semester hours') names no courses and is recorded as two 3-credit choice slots at its printed minimum. The itemized requirement therefore totals 67 semester hours, 4 above the catalog's stated 63 minimum; the catalog does not explain the gap, and the recorded total (67) is the exact itemized sum. Residency as printed: at least half of the classes in chemistry, half of the classes in biology and three of the four classes in biochemistry must be taken at Salem (the program list carries five BCHM-coded entries counting the two cross-listed courses; the catalog does not reconcile its 'four classes' wording). Further catalog anomalies disclosed, not corrected: BCHM 306 is printed at 3 Hour(s) while its description says 'Four hours of lecture'; BCHM 311's detail page prints its cross-listing with CHEM 311 while CHEM 311's prints none; BCHM 390's detail page carries a Writing Intensive general-education line that CHEM 390's does not. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan (BIOL 065 as a BCHM 306 alternative, BIOL 010 as a BIOL 101 alternative, MATH 070 as a BIOL 310 alternative, and the mathematics placement prerequisites on the CHEM and MATH detail pages) are disclosed here and are not recorded as plan prerequisites.
